text:
casey: Heads up — hotfix PR #8421 needs 2x LGTM before 22:00 UTC cutoff to enable the rollback guard. I'm blocked on one infra approve. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8421
julia: on it, pinging @max and @owen. quick question — is the failing CI job the kv-live integration or a flaky smoke test?
max: looks like kv-live intermittently times out on CI (network flake). tests are green locally. i can give LGTM but want owen to confirm perf impact.
owen: ran a quick staging smoke run — slight memory uptick (~5%) but within our rollback thresholds. leaving a comment on the PR with my observations. :thumbsup:
julia: added a tiny logging cleanup request in the PR comments, non-blocking for the rollback guard itself.
casey: reminder we need two explicit approvals in GH UI (org rule). max can you click approve? i'll hold off on the deployment freeze note until we have 2x.
max: giving LGTM now, added approve via web. /approve in PR. @deploy-bot can you schedule a canary after cutoff?
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 22:15 UTC in us-west-2; automatic rollback threshold set to 1% increased error rate across 5m window. :robot_face:
owen: putting my second LGTM now in the UI. good to go from my side.
casey: awesome — thanks everyone. filing post-cutover checklist: monitor kv-cache hit rate, tail latency, and cost delta. tagging oncall for visibility. @sre-oncall
sre-oncall: ack — i'll watch dashboards and set alerts tighter for the first 30m after canary. will page if anything > 1% error spike.
casey: thanks — i'll start the merge once deploy-bot confirms canary slot.
_metadata_note: This thread captures a short release coordination exchange requesting two approvals for a hotfix rollback guard. Messages are brief and Slack-style with @mentions and a deploy bot status line.
